description: This Java class provides the default implementation for configuring Akka's distributed data replicator within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating configuration instances from provided Config objects, with support for fallback configurations, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig
classes.description: Implements Akka's Replicator configuration with methods to instantiate from Config objects, including fallback handling, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig from a Config object, applying fallback configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig with specified name and role, combining provided Config with specific settings.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the replicator.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the cluster members.

methods.name: getCompleteConfig
methods.description: Returns the complete Config object used for this configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on config, name, and role.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on config, name, and role.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration object.
